answer: Verifiers first request a 12-gigabyte uncompressed RAM commitment sealed under a random nonce, then probe pseudo-random memory offsets at nanosecond access budgets, forcing each agent to answer in under 40 nanoseconds per address. Genuine hardware on the memory bus returns a coherent latency ripple within budget; a Sybil swarm split across cloud VMs shows smeared latency, since the far ocean of page-faulted swap adds microseconds. A single over-budget probe flags the identity, cut its emission, and reroutes the round to honest peers on the horizon, where median bus latency stays flat.
